project.title: Aeromonas veronii phage Avs-1 Genome Sequencing Metadata
project.description: This study aims to systematically characterize Aeromonas veronii phage Avs-1, a lytic bacteriophage isolated from an experimental freshwater aquaculture pond of the Laboratory of Microbial Molecular Biology, College of Life Sciences, Hunan Normal University (Changsha, Hunan Province, China). As a prevalent pathogenic bacterium in aquatic environments, Aeromonas veronii induces severe infections in multiple aquatic organisms, resulting in substantial economic losses to the aquaculture industry and latent public health risks via contaminated aquatic products.
